product_one_liner.value: Ethos uses AI to map and match people’s expertise with relevant paid opportunities—such as expert consultations, advisory work, consulting, and full-time roles—for individuals and organizations seeking human expertise.
product_one_liner.notes: The product site describes human intelligence on demand; the investor announcement explains AI voice agents and matching experts to opportunities.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage is publicly accessible and has no public pricing page or pricing link apparent.

named_customers.notes: The company/traction page reports work with more than 25 private equity firms, hedge funds, and consultancies but does not name any customers; no two named customers could be verified.

employee_band.notes: Sources conflict: LinkedIn labels the organization 2–10 employees, while Tracxn reports 671. Neither supports a band in the allowed range, so no band can be responsibly selected.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies London as headquarters; its privacy policy gives a registered office in London.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn and reporting on the company state it was founded in 2024.

eng_blog.notes: No company blog index with technical posts could be found or verified; unknown because no blog index was available to establish a negative.

public_docs.notes: The product homepage shows no public documentation, developer portal, or help center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Engineer opportunity is an AI-titled opening. Its posting is described as developing Ethos products and systems.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public privacy policy and its linked subprocessor listing and searched for company material; no named model or provider was verified.

compliance_certs.notes: The available privacy/security/legal page did not name any of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as certifications.

last_funding.notes: Ethos announced a $22.75 million Series A in May 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series A was announced in May 2026, within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The accessible company jobs listing shows expert-opportunity listings, not an employee SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest identifiable announcement is the May 2026 Series A, not a product or feature launch; no later launch announcement could be verified.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Public company/profile material identifies the founders and current CEO/CTO; no dated C-level or VP join/departure in the 12 months to the run date was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable product site and job listings reviewed did not name a CRM or sales/marketing system used by Ethos.
